name: Kalera Public Limited Company
summary: Kalera Public Limited Company, along with its various affiliates, operates as a global leader in hydroponic vertical farming. The company manages sophisticated vertical farms and dedicated technological innovation centers to cultivate a diverse range of lettuce and microgreens. These fresh agricultural products are supplied to both retail outlets and the food service industry. Beyond its core farming operations, Kalera also possesses a license for proprietary technology pertaining to geopolymer concrete. The firm maintains its principal corporate office in Orlando, Florida.
